User.title: User
User.description: Represents a synchronized lawyer account in the system

subscriptionStatus.description: License level of the user (e.g. active, expired)

subscriptionExpires.description: ISO date-time string when subscription ends

inviteCodeUsed.description: Invite code used for register verification

lastSynced.description: Last timestamp the user backed up data

cases.description: Array of legal cases owned by this user

sessions.description: Array of court sessions owned by this user

documents.description: Array of legal documents owned by this user

InviteCode.title: InviteCode
InviteCode.description: An administrative invite code for secure account creation

isUsed.description: Whether this code has been claimed

usedBy.description: The username of the account that claimed the code

createdDate.description: ISO timestamp for administrative audit logs

/users/{username}.description: Root collection for locked cloud-linked lawyer accounts

/invite_codes/{code}.description: Root collection for exclusive validated administrative invitations
